primary_task: Translate a Mermaid sequenceDiagram of a cryptographic protocol into a ProVerif model and write it to a .pv file with a short summary of queries and assumptions.

requirements.name: Read, Write, Grep, Glob
requirements.evidence: **Tools used:** Read, Write, Grep, Glob. ... **Write the model to a `.pv` file.**
requirements.basis: read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep); create and overwrite files

requirements.name: proverif
requirements.evidence: produces a ProVerif model (`.pv` file) that can be passed directly to the ProVerif verifier. ... User wants to run ProVerif on an existing .pv file — just run `proverif model.pv` directly
requirements.basis: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads) (assumes the proverif package is in the Ubuntu archive; otherwise unknown)

notes: The deliverable is the .pv file; Step 8's checklist is applied by inspection before writing, and the document lists only Read/Write/Grep/Glob as tools. Running ProVerif is out of scope per 'When NOT to Use'. Other reading: if the reachability sanity check ('Validate reachability before trusting any security query') is taken as requiring a ProVerif run, proverif becomes hard; it is installable from Ubuntu apt or buildable from source (opam/OCaml availability unknown), so the verdict would still be ACHIEVABLE unless the package cannot be obtained.
